propositions: CLI reconstruction uses overlapping frozensets and manual authorities causing parser/help drift and incomplete intercept coverage.
Every visible command grammar must be derived from a single side-effect-free argparse factory shared by execution and generation with no docs-only or manual syntax authority.
Generated package-help and overview bytes must be committed and runtime-authoritative before operation/config/mount boundaries; help must remain pre-operation without triggering handler work.
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help; exact/compatibility/hidden/retired spellings (including jira-onboard and unknown purge-bridge) must exhibit approved behavior.

Lazy route registry with semantic capability postures (error/unavailable/abstain/fallback) must prevent eager optional imports while preserving mount/init/argv/confirmation/stream/exit-code contracts.
CLI-reference generation and coverage checks must enumerate registries and parser artifacts rather than source regexes or manual command censuses.
